applicationSlogan: Complex workflows deserve clear, thoughtful interfaces.
footerNote: Built with 💜 down to the last pixel.
heroIntro: Frontend developer with 4+ years of experience turning complex business and industrial workflows into clear, maintainable web applications. I work with React, Svelte and TypeScript, and lead small development teams.
workNote: Professional work & personal projects · illustrative previews
measureInstall: Project management for the kitchen industry
workDescription: Frontend team lead for a team of three, building a Svelte 5 platform for projects, measurements and installations. Five user roles, operational dashboards, calendars and advanced filters support each stage of the workflow.
libraryIntro: A working library of React and TypeScript components, from validated forms and modals to data views, scheduling, maps and charts. Explore live previews, switch variants and read the code.
aboutIntro: I’m Daniel, a frontend developer based in Viseu, Portugal, with a degree in Technology and Multimedia Design. I build applications for business and industrial environments, bringing together interface design, frontend architecture and backend experience in Ruby on Rails.
aboutWork: At ProjectBox, I contributed to software delivered to more than 15 companies, including Domestic & General, Metro Mondego and IteCons. My work spans store competitions, visit management, live access monitoring, digital memberships and installation planning, with a focus on performance, usability and maintainability.
careerIntro: Developed and maintained applications with React, Svelte, Angular and Ruby on Rails. Led teams of three on Mind Your Visit, SmartIn and After, and led full stack development on Premiato. Built reusable UI components, integrated REST APIs and contributed to architecture and production maintenance.
degreeIntro: Bachelor’s degree, 2018–2021, at Escola Superior de Tecnologia e Gestão de Viseu. Earlier studies include a CTeSP in Web Development and Mobile Devices, with further training in IoT applications for healthcare.
exploreIntro: Try the interfaces I build: change component variants, explore interactive examples and see the code behind them.
remoteAvailable: Let’s talk about your team and what you’re building. Open to remote opportunities and relocation.
buttonIntro: A clear action in any context. Consistent variants, sizes and states.
exampleNote: Illustrative layout examples. The catalog and API will be aligned with your actual components.
cardIntro: A surface to group information and highlight the next action.
cardBody: It starts with small, well-built pieces.
inputIntro: A simple field with clear feedback and room for what matters.
name: Name
returnIntro: You can return to the portfolio and keep exploring.
actionConfirmed: Action confirmed. You can try another variant.
toastIntro: Clear feedback with a touch of personality. Four states, soft gradients and the right message at the right time.
toastSuccessText: Your changes have been saved successfully.
toastWarningText: Review the highlighted fields before continuing.
toastErrorText: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
toastInfoText: A new update is available to explore.
toastTypes: Four states, the same attention to detail.
toastPreviewHint: Click a notification to try it in the selected position.
toastPauseHint: Notifications pause while you hover or interact with them. You can dismiss them at any time.
mapSelectionUnknown: No country identified at this position.
mapSelectionError: Could not identify the marker’s country.
mapFallback: Country detection unavailable. Showing Lisbon, Portugal.
mapIntro: Explore the map, initially centred on your country’s capital with a custom marker.
mapHelp: Click the marker to see its coordinates. Click anywhere on the map to move the marker and open its coordinates. Country detection uses your IP address (ipapi); capital coordinates come from Photon. VPNs may affect the detected country.
pickerIntro: One field to choose years, months, weeks, days or time, with optional time selection in day mode. Adapted to your device and the application theme.
pickerNativeWeekHint: Choose a day in the week you want.
pickerNativeMonthHint: Choose a day in the month you want.
pickerHelp: On desktop, use the calendar or the hours and minutes menu. Use arrow keys to navigate and Enter to select. On mobile, use the native picker. Weeks run from Sunday to Saturday.
pickerValueFormats: Value formats: year YYYY, month YYYY-MM, week YYYY-Www day YYYY-MM-DD and time HH:mm. Weeks run from Sunday to Saturday, numbered after the following Monday. On mobile, year uses a native list and week uses a native date picker to choose a day in the period.
modalIntro: A focused space for your content, with a clear title, custom body and confirm or cancel actions.
modalSubmitError: Could not complete this action. Please try again.
modalDemoDescription: Update your details and confirm when you are ready.
modalLongParagraph: This extra content lets you explore scrolling inside the modal. The title, close button and actions stay visible while you read.
schedulerIntro: Organise your events in an interactive schedule. Drag to reschedule, adjust durations and recognise each event’s urgency by colour.
schedulerInvalidRange: The end must be after the start.
schedulerHelp: Select a time slot to create an event. Drag an event to reschedule it or drag its edge to adjust the duration. You can also click an event and edit its dates using the keyboard.
schedulerMobileHelp: Tap an event to edit it. Long press an event to drag it or a time slot to create an event. Use Day view for more room.
schedulerPreviewNote: Changes in this preview are discarded when you leave the page.
pickerInvalid: Select a valid date and time within the allowed range.
dropdownIntro: Choose an option using the platform’s menu style, with a blurred background and the same width as the field.
dropdownHelp: Use the arrow keys to navigate and Enter to select. On mobile and touch devices, use the native select.
dataViewIntro: Explore the same users in a table or cards, with search, filters, pagination and actions in both views.
dataViewEmptyHelp: Try a different search or clear the filters.
dataViewPreviewNote: Fictitious users for this preview. Changes are discarded when you leave the page.
switchIntro: Turn an option on or off with the application’s switch style.
formsIntro: A user form with Formik state and Yup validation, field errors and detailed submission feedback.
formsAccepted: I accept the conditions of this demonstration
formsPasswordHint: At least 8 characters, with uppercase, lowercase and a number.
formsServerEmail: The simulated service could not verify this email. Try again with simulation turned off.
formsSubmitError: The user could not be created.
formsSuccess: User {{name}} created successfully in this preview.
formsPreviewNote: Local preview only: nothing is sent or stored. Use fictitious data.
chartsIntro: Interactive line and doughnut charts with two colour palettes and two visual styles.
error404Description: The page you’re looking for may have moved, or the link might be incorrect. Let’s get you somewhere familiar.
error500Description: We couldn’t load this page right now. Please try again, or return to the home page.
internshipIntro: Developed frontend and backend features, helped maintain internal tools and worked on client projects in an agile team. Built a practical foundation in web development and software maintenance.
